test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Refrigeration & Air Conditioning Mechanic) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: Which of the following regarding ventilation inspection and commissioning is INCORRECT?

options.text: A well-balanced ventilation system cannot help optimise energy usage by preventing unnecessary over-ventilation
Proper ventilation is crucial for maintaining good indoor air quality
Testing the functionality of automated controls that regulate the ventilation system, such as sensors and actuators
Many building codes and standards require regular ventilation system checks to ensure compliance

solution:
The correct answer is __Option 1.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• A well-balanced ventilation system__ is capable of optimising energy usage by preventing unnecessary over-ventilation.
 
• Proper ventilation is essential for maintaining good indoor air quality by ensuring adequate air exchange and pollutant removal.
 
• Testing the functionality of automated controls such as sensors and actuators is crucial during ventilation inspection and commissioning.
 
• Regular ventilation system checks are required by many building codes and standards to ensure compliance and maintain system efficiency.
 
• Option 1 is __incorrect__ as it contradicts the role of a well-balanced ventilation system in energy optimisation.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Ventilation Inspection:**

 
 
• Involves evaluating the performance of ventilation systems to ensure they meet design specifications and operational requirements.
 
• Includes checking airflows, balancing ductwork, and verifying system cleanliness.
 
 
 
• **Commissioning of Ventilation Systems:**
 
 
• Ensures that systems are installed and functioning correctly as per design intentions.
 
• Helps identify and rectify any installation or operational issues early on.
